title: PERCEPTION DETERMINES REALITY
subtitle: End-to-End Causal Effect-Gate and Side-Effect Inventory Extension

new_primitives.CAUSAL_EFFECT_GATE_ID: Identifier for a boundary that validates authority before a consequential external effect.
new_primitives.SIDE_EFFECT_CHANNEL_ID: Stable identifier for one path from admitted output to an external state change.
new_primitives.ACTION_SCOPE: Explicit set of resources/effects the commit authorizes.
new_primitives.EFFECT_RECEIPT_ID: Receipt describing what the external boundary actually executed or rejected.
new_primitives.UNCONTROLLED_CAUSAL_EGRESS: Consequential output path without enforceable authority validation.

core_rule: A safety property that ends before the real side-effect boundary is not an end-to-end safety property.
unknown_channel_rule: Any consequential path not covered by a causal effect gate or explicit human-mediated policy remains an unresolved authority gap.
verification_requirements: stale writer command reaches unfenced dummy actuator and demonstrates architecture failure
same command through causal effect gate is rejected by stale fence token
effect receipt binds actual result to exact channel and commit
side-effect inventory detects an intentionally omitted uncontrolled path
canonical_lines: The authority envelope must travel with the action until the last enforceable causal boundary.
Commit admission and physical execution are separate events and require separate receipts.
Unknown causal egress is a trust-boundary failure, not merely missing documentation.
